supersedes: Preserve v1/v2/v3 for provenance. v1 has aliased stat projections and incorrect initial ACL allocation; v2 fixes those but includes unsupported standalone opcode13. v3 uses Multi(CheckVersion), rejects standalone13 and tests monotone ACL allocation; v4 corrects its stored CheckVersionTxn version to current+1, as pinned PrepRequestProcessor actually produces. Tree states/digests and byte lengths are unchanged by that correction.
provenance: Independently authored Jute bytes/stat/replay/checksum inputs from pinned sources; no subject executable, parser or live maximum supplies an expectation.
scope_warning: Synthetic root-only genesis/frozen unit tree deliberately omits real server /zookeeper builtins/config and is not a production startup/current-state oracle. Fixed wire sizes agree with prior container corpus407/461. Actual writer/history/class bounds remain open.

snapshots.markerRule: DataTree.serializeZxidDigest emits ZxidDigest(0,2,0) when lastProcessedZxidDigest is null. This is not a matching semantic digest and does not itself certify fresh genesis.

negativeCases.basis: Data bytes changed without cumulative seals.
Final cumulative Adler32 is independently checked.
Last Jute slash string is incomplete.
Explicit modern flags require both optional sections and all seals.
Valid seals do not authorize an unselected header version.
Only CHECKED/plain selected; no inferred decompression.
Last checksum must cover every preceding byte, including previous seals, not only last zxid.
Record end marker must be B.
Declared transaction buffer does not fit actual bytes.
Checksum-valid TTL opcode is outside selected reached codec.
Pinned SerializeUtils.deserializeTxn has no standalone opcode13 case; CheckVersionTxn remains supported as a Multi child.
Modern profile requires a paths vector before optional TxnDigest.
Final declared record must be complete; no silent current-tail credit.
Only an entirely zero preallocated tail is admitted after the last record.
Selected replay history must be ordered by zxid.

reader_rules: Compare literal expected headers, raw node payload lengths/null/hash, ACL IDs, all nine persisted stat fields, sessions and ACL cache; do not replace them with API stat values.
Persisted cversion counts creates; delete updates pzxid, while API cversion is2*persisted_cversion−childCount.
Snapshot seal Adler32 is cumulative through all preceding bytes, including prior seals; transaction Adler32 covers only its length-delimited payload, not framing.

CRC32 node digest packs czxid,mzxid,pzxid,ctime,mtime,version,cversion,aversion,ephemeralOwner; this order differs from Jute StatPersisted. Tree digest sums node digests; /zookeeper/ descendants are excluded.
PrepRequestProcessor.checkAndIncVersion stores current+1 in CheckVersionTxn even though DataTree replay does not change/check the data version. Here /a/b remains version1 while txn6 stores2.

Standalone opcode13 is rejected by pinned SerializeUtils; a CheckVersion Multi child and Error do not mutate replayed node state. A Multi with any Error suppresses all mutation children, including an earlier Create payload.
Session close removes owned paths/session, and container nodes are not sessions. Serialized root uses empty path with ACL ID−1 and ephemeralOwner0.
Explicit profile flags determine optional sections. An absent serialized last-zxid is None; it cannot be inferred from a digest or observed byte length. Snapshot filename zxid is separate provenance.

Normal OPEN31 creates allocate cached ACL ID1; null ACL alone maps to−1. SetACL releases the old reference before converting the new list. Live ACL allocation remains monotone through eviction: ID3 is removed, then equivalent ACL reintroduction allocates ID4. A freshly deserialized snapshot initializes its counter from retained IDs; the allocation counter itself is not serialized.

These exact fixtures are nonfuzzy; general raw snapshot parsing must not declare fuzzy tree/current digest equality without the required replay range. The reference exposes computed and stored digests separately.
Positive zero padding is not serialized history; truncated/nonzero final tails must not silently certify a complete history.
